name: How much does it cost to add a niche during a shower remodel?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to add a niche during a shower remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a shower niche typically ranges from $300 to $900 as part of an overall bathroom remodel. Factors affecting the price include whether you choose a standard prefab unit or a custom-framed design spanning multiple stud bays. Custom framing that requires cutting studs and adding structural headers increases labor costs. Tile complexity also influences pricing; intricate mosaic inlays, mitered tile edges, or solid quartz sill slabs require meticulous hand cuts and detailed grouting compared to basic porcelain tile.
acceptedAnswer.description: Adding a shower niche generally costs between $300 and $900 during a remodel, depending on framing complexity, custom sizing, and tile detailing.
